pr_title: Fixed failing UT TestWriteKubeletConfigFiles by removing privilege check and adding proper error handling
pr_body:

#### What this PR does / why we need it:
Upon running test `TestWriteKubeletConfigFiles` with root privileges, test is failing with following error

```
Failed  === RUN   TestWriteKubeletConfigFiles
[dryrun] Would back up kubelet config file to /etc/kubernetes/tmp/kubeadm-kubelet-config2053167552/config.yaml
[kubelet-start] Writing kubelet configuration to file "/etc/kubernetes/tmp/kubeadm-upgrade-dryrun670589101/config.yaml"
[dryrun] Would write file "/var/lib/kubelet/config.yaml" with content:
[dryrun] Would back up kubelet config file to /etc/kubernetes/tmp/kubeadm-kubelet-config1213632659/config.yaml
    postupgrade_test.go:169: Expected error contains "no kubelet component config found.*no such file or directory", got error writing kubelet configuration to file: no kubelet component config found
--- FAIL: TestWriteKubeletConfigFiles (0.00s)
}
```
This PR removes user privilege check and add appropriate error handling for UT.

there is no point of testing dryrun==false in this unit test.
@neolit123 - can we expedite the fix? Won't this block all PR from submission (or is there a way to skip this test)?

> Won't this block all PR from submission (or is there a way to skip this test)?

no, the test is currently skipped in OSS CI because we don't run as root, but fails for anyone who runs the unit test in an env where it *does* run as root

@neolit123 If we remove the privilege check then test will fail for non-root. As suggested here, https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/128762#issuecomment-2471781809 we should override the base path to test in a /tmp/temp dir (for e.g.). Thoughts/suggestions pls ?

> @neolit123 If we remove the privilege check then test will fail for non-root. As suggested here, [#128762 (comment)](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/128762#issuecomment-2471781809) we should override the base path to test in a /tmp/temp dir (for e.g.). Thoughts/suggestions pls ?

if dryrun is always true it will use a tmp path. please check again.

> > @neolit123 If we remove the privilege check then test will fail for non-root. As suggested here, [#128762 (comment)](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/128762#issuecomment-2471781809) we should override the base path to test in a /tmp/temp dir (for e.g.). Thoughts/suggestions pls ?
> 
> if dryrun is always true it will use a tmp path. please check again.

I agree to this. However currently, it is using tmp path as specified by [this](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/0926587bf00cd931ffafa98b4780903a1b512a7b/cmd/kubeadm/app/constants/constants.go#L38) with dry run true, which is privileged in most envs. One way I could think of is giving permissions to user but that violates the design. Please correct if I have missed anything.

ok, NVM. seems like https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/0926587bf00cd931ffafa98b4780903a1b512a7b/cmd/kubeadm/app/constants/constants.go#L623

creates the tmp dir under `/etc/kubernetes` for dry-run and to hide it from regular users. 

in that case just modify the signature:
```
err := WriteKubeletConfigFiles(tc.cfg, kubeletConfigDir, tc.patchesDir, false os.Stdout)
```

in the UT `kubeletConfigDir ` can be a dir under `/tmp`.
for real runs it can be `constants.KubeletRunDirectory` or a `cosntants.CreateTempDir` when dry-running.

we should not run unit test as root by the way

It seems that the issue went unnoticed in the CI environment because the unit tests were not executed with root user. Fortunately, it was just the returned error message not matching our expectations, and the fix is coming.

We don't run unit tests as root by design because we had many tests depending on being root which doesn't work for local development and highly suggests an os level integration test rather than a unit test.

We should be overriding the base path so we can test in a tempdir and not try to write to the actual global path.
